issue.title: `gh search code` leaves highlight background active when terminal scrolls

### Describe the bug

`gh search code` can leave the match highlight background active when it writes a newline.

I reproduced this with `GH_PAGER=cat gh search code '[cfg_attr(miri, test)]'` after moving the cursor to the bottom of the terminal. When the output scrolls, the terminal makes a new row while the yellow background is still active. The unused cells on that row remain yellow.

![Full-width yellow backgrounds appear after the output starts scrolling](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3d7db84a-37cc-44f8-b418-0f9c1520f622)

### Affected version

```text
gh version 2.102.0 (2026-09-30)
https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/tag/v2.102.0
```

### Steps to reproduce the behavior

1. Move the cursor to the bottom of the terminal:

   ```shell
   printf '\n%.0s' $(seq 1 "$(tput lines)")
   ```

2. Run the search without a pager:

   ```shell
   GH_PAGER=cat gh search code '[cfg_attr(miri, test)]'
   ```

3. Observe the full-width yellow backgrounds after the terminal starts scrolling.

### Expected vs actual behavior

Expected: The yellow background ends after each matched range, including when a match ends immediately before a newline.
